answer: That makes each additional alias in a cluster strictly dilutive, so the operator pays the bond and the willow fee for a smaller payout than one honest position would earn. Because the forge cluster is derived from funding history, the split is applied at settlement and the oasis audit lists each share. The reward pool is divided per detected cluster rather than per key, so 159 linked identities split one share instead of collecting 159 of them. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
